_doc: Prompts copiados de porty-ads-sunra-rompts.md (secciones 4 a 6). Ver ajustes en _ajustes.
_ajustes: Ojos: el doc dice ovalados; los SVG oficiales usan círculos, así que el bloque de estilo dice round.
Referencias: se manda solo lo que pide cada anuncio y se renumera "reference N" si la numeración salta (anuncios 3 y 9).
style: Calm editorial advertising piece for a mobile investing app, in the spirit of Notion or Linear: lots of air, clear hierarchy, maximum 3 main elements. Flat warm ivory background #FBFBFA. Text color charcoal #2F3437, secondary text warm gray #787774. A single accent color: terracotta #D98E5D. Profit green #346538 and loss red #9F2F2D only on numbers. Typography: Plus Jakarta Sans style geometric sans-serif, bold headlines with slightly negative letter-spacing (no inflated letters, no comic or script fonts). White #FFFFFF cards with a very thin 8% gray border and ~16px radius, no heavy shadows, no gradients, no glossy 3D. Small hand-drawn details (underline, sparkle) in terracotta, used sparingly. Mascot "Porty": use the attached reference images EXACTLY as the mascot: a slightly irregular soft terracotta pebble with no body, no arms and no hands, two dark charcoal round eyes and a thick rounded gentle curved smile. Do NOT redraw, restyle, symmetrize or deform it; only scale or crop it. All text in Rioplatense Spanish with correct spelling and every accent. Render ONLY the quoted text, no extra words, no logos. Forbidden: coins, dollar-sign symbols, rockets, charts that only go up, gold bars, bulls, cash, neon, gradients, stock photos.

story.line: Format: vertical story 9:16 with the top 13% and bottom 18% free of key content.

ad01.prompt: Brand lockup at the top: small Porty avatar (reference 1) next to the word "Porty" in bold. Centered headline, two lines: "Tu cartera bajó." / "¿Por qué?" with a thin hand-drawn terracotta underline under "¿Por qué?". Below it a small gray line: "Porty te lo explica en criollo." Below, a modern smartphone mockup with thin frame and realistic tall proportions (about 1:2.1), cropped by the bottom edge of the image. On its ivory screen, a chat: a light gray user bubble aligned right with "¿Por qué bajé hoy?"; below it a reply in a white card with hairline border: "Bajaste 1,2% sobre todo por NVDA, que cayó tras su reporte. El resto está estable." where "NVDA" is inside a small rounded pill and "1,2%" is in deep red #9F2F2D. A small Porty avatar (reference 2, concerned mood) sits next to the reply. Under the reply, two small white suggestion chips: "¿Y el resto de mi cartera?" and "¿Qué pasó con NVDA?". Tiny gray caption: "Ejemplo ilustrativo".

ad02.prompt: Brand lockup at the top: small Porty avatar (reference 1) and "Porty". Centered headline: "Abrí. Mirá cómo vas. Cerrá." with a thin hand-drawn terracotta underline under "cómo vas." Below, gray line: "Tu cartera de un vistazo, sin ruido." Then a tall modern smartphone mockup (about 1:2.1), thin frame, cropped by the bottom edge. On its screen: gray label "Tu cartera"; big bold number "US$ 12.480"; below it "−0,4% hoy" in red and "+1,3% este mes" in green; a thin charcoal line sparkline that goes up and down (not only up) ending in a small terracotta dot; a row with a small Porty avatar (reference 1) and a white card saying "Día tranquilo. Nada raro en tu cartera."; a gray section label "Posiciones" followed by two editorial rows with hairline separators: "NVDA" (subtitle "Nvidia") with "−1,2%" in red, and "VOO" (subtitle "ETF · S&P 500") with "+0,4%" in green. Tiny gray caption: "Ejemplo ilustrativo".

ad03.prompt: Brand lockup at the top: small Porty avatar and "Porty". Centered bold headline in two lines: "Preguntale lo que" / "no te animás a preguntar." with a thin hand-drawn terracotta underline under "no te animás". Below, three white pill-shaped question chips stacked and left-aligned, the first with a terracotta outline: "¿Qué es un ETF?", "¿Qué es un dividendo?", "¿Por qué cae el mercado?". Below them, a small Porty avatar (reference 1) next to a white card with the answer: "Un ETF es una canasta de acciones que comprás de una sola vez. Por ejemplo, el SPY sigue a las 500 empresas más grandes de EE. UU." At the bottom, a large Porty (reference 2, with the four-point sparkle) partly cropped by the bottom edge, with its full face visible. No phone mockup in this piece.

ad04.prompt: Brand lockup at the top: small Porty avatar and "Porty". Very large bold centered headline in two lines: "No te dice" / "qué comprar." with a thick hand-drawn terracotta underline under "qué comprar." Below, gray line: "Te ayuda a entender lo que ya tenés." In the middle, a tilted pill-shaped sticker with gray text "¡Comprá ya!" crossed out by a terracotta strike line (the text must remain readable). At the bottom, a large smiling Porty (reference 1), centered and partly cropped by the bottom edge, face fully visible.

ad05.prompt: Brand lockup at the top: small Porty avatar and "Porty". Centered headline in two lines: "¿Vas en camino" / "a tu meta?" with a thin hand-drawn terracotta underline under "en camino". Gray line: "Contale qué querés lograr. Porty arma el plan." Then a tall modern smartphone mockup (about 1:2.1) cropped by the bottom edge. On its screen: a small Porty avatar (reference 1) beside a white card "Japón va en camino. El fondo de emergencia viene un poco atrasado."; then two goal rows with hairline separators: "Viaje a Japón" with "60 %" on the right, small gray line "US$ 2.400 de US$ 4.000 · abril 2027" and a thin charcoal progress bar filled 60%; "Fondo de emergencia" with "35 %", gray line "US$ 1.050 de US$ 3.000 · atrasada" and a progress bar filled 35%; then a small line "Entre todas: US$ 3.450 de US$ 7.000". Tiny gray caption: "Ejemplo ilustrativo".

ad06.prompt: Brand lockup at the top: small Porty avatar and "Porty". Centered headline in two lines: "Tu cartera de eToro," / "sin cargar nada." with a thin hand-drawn terracotta underline under "sin cargar nada." Gray line: "Conectá tu cuenta. Solo lectura." Then a tall modern smartphone mockup (about 1:2.1) cropped by the bottom edge. On its screen: bold title "Conectá tu cuenta de eToro"; gray paragraph "Porty trae tus posiciones y las mantiene al día, así no tenés que cargarlas a mano."; a full-width charcoal button with ivory text "Conectar eToro"; small gray text "Solo lectura"; below, a white card with a terracotta circle containing a white check mark, bold "12 posiciones importadas" and gray "Se actualizan solas." Do NOT draw any eToro logo, only the word in text. Tiny gray caption: "Ejemplo ilustrativo".

ad07.prompt: Brand lockup at the top: small Porty avatar and "Porty". Centered headline in two lines: "¿Estás muy" / "concentrado?" with a thin hand-drawn terracotta underline under "concentrado?" Gray line: "Porty te avisa cuando un sector pesa demasiado." Then a tall modern smartphone mockup (about 1:2.1) cropped by the bottom edge. On its screen: gray label "Tu cartera por sector"; four horizontal bar rows with the name on the left and the percentage on the right: "Tecnología" "62 %" with a terracotta bar, "Finanzas" "18 %", "Salud" "12 %", "Consumo" "8 %" with light gray bars (bars proportional to the numbers); below, a small Porty avatar (reference 2, concerned) beside a white card with bold "Tecnología pesa 62 % de tu cartera." followed by regular "Porty te lo marca cuando un sector supera el 40 %." Tiny gray caption: "Ejemplo ilustrativo".

ad08.prompt: Brand lockup at the top: small Porty avatar and "Porty". Centered headline in two lines: "Diversificá según" / "tu perfil." with a thin hand-drawn terracotta underline under "tu perfil." Gray line: "Porty te muestra ideas que le faltan a tu cartera." Then a tall modern smartphone mockup (about 1:2.1) cropped by the bottom edge. On its screen: gray label "Tu perfil de inversor" and three small white pills in one row: "Moderado", "Largo plazo", "Crecimiento"; a small Porty avatar (reference 1) beside a white card "Tus 6 posiciones son 100 % de EE. UU. Mirá qué le falta."; two white idea cards: first bold "ETF de acciones internacionales", gray "Suma empresas de otros países.", and a small pill with a terracotta dot "Buen encaje"; second bold "ETF de bonos", gray "Suma estabilidad a tu cartera.", pill "Encaje medio". Tiny gray caption: "Ejemplo ilustrativo. Información educativa, no es asesoramiento financiero." Do not write any specific ticker symbols.

ad09.prompt: Brand lockup at the top: small Porty avatar and "Porty". Centered headline in two lines: "Registrá tus compras" / "hablando." with a thin hand-drawn terracotta underline under "hablando." Gray line: "Contale a Porty. Vos confirmás." Then a tall modern smartphone mockup (about 1:2.1) cropped by the bottom edge. On its screen: a light gray user bubble aligned right "Compré 5 VOO hoy"; a small Porty avatar (reference 2, answered) beside a white card "Listo, lo preparé. ¿Lo confirmás?"; below, a white card with three rows (label gray on the left, value bold on the right): "Operación" "Compra", "Activo" "VOO", "Cantidad" "5"; then a full-width charcoal button "Confirmar" and a gray text button "Cancelar". Tiny gray caption: "Ejemplo ilustrativo".

ad10.prompt: Brand lockup at the top: small Porty avatar and "Porty". Centered headline in two lines: "Porty te avisa" / "solo cuando importa." with a thin hand-drawn terracotta underline under "solo cuando importa." Gray line: "Nunca más de 3 avisos automáticos por día." Then three stacked white push-notification cards with hairline borders and large radius, each with a small rounded app icon holding the Porty avatar (reference 1), a tiny gray header and a bold title and a gray body: "Porty · ahora" / "NVDA bajó de US$ 150" / "Tu alerta de precio se activó."; "Porty · 9:00" / "AAPL presenta resultados mañana" / "Después del cierre."; "Porty · sábado" / "Tu semana está lista" / "Mirá cómo te fue y qué viene." Tiny gray caption: "Ejemplo ilustrativo". At the bottom, a large smiling Porty (reference 1) partly cropped by the bottom edge, face fully visible.
